requirements.requirement: Preserve the complete W00-W13 six-capability-layer work program and stable requirement identities, including future and externally blocked work.
Bind every mandatory acceptance case to explicit requirements, an oracle, expected failure behavior and a scheduled gate; test totals cannot replace missing obligations.
Freeze governing semantics and expected results before implementation; amendments preserve predecessors, reasons and authorization posture.
Keep scope, authority, observations, simulations, native admission, approval and comparative research conclusions separate.
Produce cumulative decisions, dependency/risk registers, source custody, reproducible archives and independently invokable qualification.
Reject incomplete or inflated completion claims; native P/PPI admission requires real selected schema/interpreter/host evidence, not locally invented substitutes.
Represent Asset, Actor, Flow, Dependency, Policy, Cohort, Observation, Obligation, Transition, Effect, Authority and Evidence as typed objects.
Represent old persisted data, new-data producers, consumers, resumable workloads, attached policies and old/new use-case/cohort mappings.
Carry source identity, declared time, version, jurisdiction, evidence references, uncertainty and scope explicitly.
Validate closed shapes, exact types, unique identifiers and reference-kind compatibility; refuse unsupported semantic inputs.
Preserve incomplete discovery and observation coverage as unknown or partial, never as proof of exhaustive absence.
Represent identity, storage, policy and workload examples using the same kernel primitives; deeper domain semantics are separate profiles.
Define a bounded, unambiguous canonical encoding, hash domains, model identity, profile identity, compiler identity and separate IR/receipt identities.
Compile accepted finite models without network, wall-clock, randomness, agent calls, untrusted code loading or external effects.
Resolve exact profile versions, references, target/cohort scopes and state transitions; reject unsupported operators and ambiguous interpretation.
Derive a deterministic dependency order, obligation instructions and evidence/authority/adapter requirements with source traceability.
Detect explicit order cycles, conflicting or unordered target changes, initial-state mismatches and literal contradictions without hiding them.
Allow unknown runtime facts to compile into unresolved obligations; compilation does not prove eligibility, completeness, admission or operational safety.
Replay compilation against the original model and pinned compiler; a rehashed forged IR or receipt must not pass.
Enforce finite byte, depth, node, object, expression, reference and transition budgets; machine-readable diagnostic and refusal codes are stable.
Qualify identity/delegation predicates for issuer, audience, scope, token flows, expiration, key changes and revocation.
Qualify storage/data predicates for schemas, replicas, custody, readers/writers, consistency, retention, residency and inventory reconciliation.
Qualify policy predicates for purpose, consent, authority, access, retention, widening and incompatibility.
Qualify long-running workload predicates for suspension/resume, checkpoints, delayed writes, version coexistence and drainage.
Each installed profile supplies versioned schema, predicates, transitions, diagnostics, fixtures and qualifications without changing kernel meanings.
Distinguish unconditional order, conditional order, coexistence, exclusion, unknown and unsatisfiable constraints.
Analyze strongly connected components and distinguish an invalid order cycle from an explicitly supported coexistence phase.
Expose incompatible plans, unresolved blockers and affected cohorts with requirement-linked explanations.
Generate admissible plans under declared constraints; never treat an optimization ranking as a safety rule.
Reassess planning when declared dependencies, policy or coverage changes; no automatic discovery-completeness inference.
Define allowed lifecycle and side states including blocked, paused, inconclusive, compensating and recovery-required; reject unrestricted reversal.
Derive transition prerequisites from declared profiles, cohort mappings and compatibility constraints.
Retirement requires legacy producer fencing, accepted outstanding-work and stored-state dispositions, consumer readiness and adequate fresh coverage.
Require scoped current authorization and a recovery plan that preserves security floors before retirement.
Dormant/resumable legacy workers block premature retirement; legitimate satisfaction must permit progress.
Targeted rollback affects only authorized cohorts and cannot silently revive revoked authority or discard newer security knowledge.
Implement submit, compile, observe, assess, plan, prepare, approve, commit, verify, pause, resume, compensate, retire and replay with versioned state.
Use a durable event journal and recoverable projections; recorded observations, clocks and nondeterministic outcomes are explicit inputs.
Reconcile current observations with compiled obligations and report eligible or blocked transitions with exact scope.
Replay decisions without reissuing effects; restart at consequential stages reconstructs the accepted state.
Handle concurrency, idempotency, duplicate observations, divergence, stale plans and bounded retries.
Keep persistence/transport replaceable behind a tested contract; an initial SQLite implementation has explicit host and power-loss assumptions.
Define typed evidence for models, observations, coverage, policy assessments, approvals, effects and replay.
Qualify coverage, compatibility, temporal-safety, authority, cutover, retirement and replay courts with declared assumptions and limits.
Distinguish asserted, computed, replayed, witnessed and recognized evidence; no status promotion by declaration.
Reject fabricated PASS results, missing provenance, stale evidence and expired or out-of-scope approvals.
Bind exact models, plans, evidence, evaluator identities and receipts; CMBA/DKN integration is explicit and uses qualified pinned versions.
Court success is scoped admissibility evidence, not self-authorizing operational permission or universal truth.
Effects follow prepare-authorize-commit-observe through restricted adapters; simulations/read-only modes do not acquire production rights.
Bind migration, plan, target, cohort, pre/post-state, policy/evidence, idempotency key, principal, expiry, retries and recovery requirements.
Validate the relevant preconditions again at the point of effect; advertise any lack of atomic precondition enforcement.
Handle lost acknowledgments and partial/uncertain effects by reconciliation before retry, not presumed failure.
Consume approvals at most as specified and refuse target substitution, scope widening and replay.
Compensation and rollback preserve security floors; unknown irreversible outcomes require explicit recovery disposition.
Adapter capabilities, idempotency, effects, preconditions, time/resource limits and compensation boundaries are inspectable.
Agents receive bounded unresolved-obligation work orders with necessary context and no implicit effect authority.
Expose documented JSON ABI and CLI for actual implemented operations with parity and typed results.
Accept agent observations/proposals through validation; they cannot silently amend accepted rules, drop blockers or approve their own effects.
Refuse commit unless a qualified adapter and valid authority context are bound; process success is not permission.
Support a full investigation-submission-assessment cycle without requiring repeated reasoning over all settled history.
Provide obligation-first graph, timeline, inventory, policy, evidence, court, effect-history and replay/diff views.
Display status by machine-readable assessment identity; imported/claimed reports remain unverified until checked.
The workbench and agents use the same headless decision semantics; presentation does not change eligibility.
Provide an optional dark-mode native UI while distinguishing sample data, observed data and actual host authority.
Keep local file effects explicit and scoped; viewing/importing evidence cannot install code, fetch data, sign or authorize deployment.
Provide profile and adapter SDK contracts, discovery, compatibility negotiation and conformance; unknown capabilities refuse.
Separate data-only capability discovery from trusted handler installation and effect authorization.
Qualify filesystem/SQLite fixtures and read-only repository, release, HTTP, deployment, job and storage observation interfaces with clear availability.
Bind actual P/PPI/UCM/CMBA/DKN/CHC integrations by exact version and source/native receipts; missing native artifacts remain blockers.
Demonstrate a new profile and observer without kernel modification; no data-supplied import path or arbitrary executable loader.
Build finite simulations of delayed events, partitions, stale evidence, authority conflicts, crashes and partial effects.
Exercise compiler, graph, temporal, lifecycle, effect, recovery, agent and evidence failures with paired safe-progress cases.
Freeze requirements, fixtures, expected results and test identities; do not rewrite the oracle to fit the implementation.
Run exact-source clean extraction, selected reproducible rebuilds, corpus and current model-reference checks with terminal receipts.
Retain unsuccessful runs and interruptions; only complete admitted evidence can satisfy a gate.
Qualify actual target environments independently and keep simulations, same-author checks and independent reviews distinct.
The end-to-end scenario includes dormant worker, persisted legacy reader, wrong-cohort approval, stale revocation, lost acknowledgment and safe retirement.
Experimental-fidelity gates refuse productivity, economic or deployment conclusions lacking their own observed evidence.
Deliver source, installable library/CLI, optional controller/workbench, profile pack, schemas, docs, reproducible demo and closed evidence package.
Document binding versus semantic evaluation versus recognition versus enforcement versus observation; preserve residual limits.
Provide human/agent orientation, protocol/API, operations, threat model, qualification, migration/rollback, contributor and replay guidance.
Measure migration-design errors, safe progress and supervisory effort against a competent conventional system with equivalent inputs/tool access.
Count initial modeling, adaptation, debugging, review, AI use and human supervision; independent development and replication cannot be simulated by one author.
Keep release qualification and comparative research conclusions separate; preserve customer-selected versions and no forced updates.
